definition: Supplied A w S f says f is in S or has a reason at w supplied from S; one reason suffices at each step, so reasons are alternatives and joint requirements are not represented. Strict A w s t says some reason for t is supplied from s. Foundation A w s t says s is terminal, Strict A w s t holds, and t is not supplied from any terminal fact other than s. SingleStop A w t says any two terminal facts supplying t are the same. Indispensable means only this: it is not a modal claim that t could not have had another source.
note: Analyst-stated for #746. A second terminal fact that also supplies the target removes the status from both, as the twin-roots model shows.
